changelog:
Initial release of crypto-skill.

- Provides real-time crypto prices, gas data, wallet balances, token info, trending tokens, and ENS/name resolution.
- No API keys required; all endpoints are public.
- Supports major EVM and non-EVM chains: Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Solana, and more.
- Returns data for price conversions, gas estimates, portfolio summaries, and trending coins.
- Resolves ENS and Basenames automatically; includes conversion to USD for balances.
- Includes safety rules: never provide financial advice, always present timestamped data, and disclaim trending tokens.
summary: Real-time crypto prices, gas, trending tokens, wallet balances, ENS resolution, and token info for OpenClaw agents. Zero API keys required. Zero setup. Use when the user asks about crypto prices, token info, wallet balances, gas costs, trending coins, name resolution, or any blockchain data lookup.
